why: Q.3(d) 'Which of the following shapes show the coastal part of Brazil correctly?' — the four alternatives (i)-(iv) are printed as land-and-sea outline diagrams with no text whatever, so the question is unanswerable without them and they cannot be transcribed as option strings. The crop leaks no answer: it is the option set itself.
Q.3(e) 'Which of the following shapes show the coastal part of India correctly?' — same shape as Q.3(d): the four alternatives are outline diagrams with no text. The crop is the option set.

Q.3(f) 'which shape correctly represents the hemisphere in which India lies?' — the four alternatives are semicircle diagrams whose only labels are the letters N. and S. marking which end of the axis is north. Nothing in the text layer records which way up each one is drawn, so the diagram is required.
Q.3(g) 'which correctly represents the hemisphere in which Brazil mainly lies?' — same shape as Q.3(f): four semicircle diagrams labelled only N. and S.
